title: beCasKAS samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the input samplesheet CSV

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must contain only letters, numbers, underscores, dots, and hyphens; must be unique.

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1 must be a path to a .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, or .fq.gz file

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2 must be a path to a .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, or .fq.gz file

condition.errorMessage: condition must be one of: input, control, treatment

replicate.errorMessage: replicate must be a positive integer

control_id.errorMessage: control_id must be a sample_id from this samplesheet (the input sample for MACS2 -c)
